events.title: RAW ORDIO WHITE PARTY
events.description: Bundy, get ready to dress in white and party all night as RAW ORDIO bring their high-energy live electronic rock show to Blackflag! Iconic rock anthems, huge beats, live performance and a dance floor that doesn’t stop. Doors open at 5pm, with two killer opening acts from 7pm followed by Raw Ordio.

events.title: Che Burns With Band
events.description: Che Burns returns to Blackflag in Coolum, taking over the main venue for a massive hometown show with his full band. Following a run of sold-out performances and a recent Song of the Year win at the Sunshine Coast Music Awards, Che is bringing his biggest live production yet to the Sunshine Coast. Joined by Cora, Happy Valley and Cherry Nova for a night of live music you won’t want to miss.
